objects.name: Analytic 2269
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a Windows process enabling promiscuous or monitor mode on a wireless adapter (netsh wlan, WinPcap/Npcap driver load, etc.) on an Industrial Control System (ICS) workstation that is not a designated wireless management station, indicating preparation for wireless interception consistent with this technique's reconnaissance phase. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.
